data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German ‘ger’ meaning ‘spear’ and ‘wald’ meaning ‘rule’, Jerold signifies ‘spear rule’ in Old English. This name has a strong association with warriors and rulers. The name Jerold carries the meaning “Spear rule” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jerold usually hope their child will grow to embody spear rule and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jerold total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: Jerold is a name that resonates with strength, leadership, and courage. Historically, it has been common among European nobility and those who wielded military and political power. This name invokes images of gallant knights charging into battle, rulers strategizing for the betterment of their people, and champions upholding the honor and integrity of their kingdoms. These historical connotations continue to influence the reputation of the name today, making it a popular choice for those seeking to imbue their child with a sense of power, resilience, and determination.
data.spiritual_significance: At its core, Jerold carries deep spiritual significance as it represents God's protection and guidance in matters of power, leadership, and defense. The name reflects not only the human desire to rule and protect but also the divine will behind it. The spear signifies the power of God to pierce through darkness and bring forth light, transforming hearts, minds, and circumstances. By choosing the name Jerold, parents may be expressing their faith in God granting their child the wisdom, courage, and strength to rule justly and defend the values they hold dear.
